text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun is running in a
scrimmage today.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Trainer! What's the strategy for today?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Should I zoom forward from behind? Or
run at the
speed of sound and leave
everyone in my vapor
trail?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! Are you sure?
choice_data_list: Let's go with whatever strategy yo...
Let's go with the strategy you like

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Like, really?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! ☆ Yay! This calls for a change of
plans!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No target for today! I'll come from the
outside
and blow past everyone! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's changed her strategy right before
a race
just like this numerous times.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Most racers usually get stuck in the rut
of their
usual tactics.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As they experience more and more
races, they
establish their style as a front
runner, pace chaser, late surger, or end
closer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But Mayano Top Gun isn't a normal
racer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She changes her style before each race

depending on how she feels.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yaaahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's become a true freewheeling
specialist, able
to find her way to victory
no matter how she
starts.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yay, I won! ♪ Heehee. What'd you
think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Was I cool? If you say so, I'll hug you
real tight! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Or, or! Did you maybe think... you
know?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: That I can still get stronger?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...! Whoa! ♪ Now I'm excited to train
after this
too! ☆
choice_data_list: Yeah. I want to see you run and sh...
Yeah. I want to see you shine even...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, it's not easy training a
gifted,
freewheeling racer like her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Different tactics means different skill
sets she'll
need to learn at practice.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! So this is how I'm going to shine
the
brightest...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh! Look at that smile, Trainer! ♪
choice_data_list: (Still, if it means seeing a smile...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun! That was incredible!
You ran with such passion, it felt like
you were already
excited for your next
race!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, you picked up on that? It's
because my
engines were fueled with
feelings for my
Trainer! ☆

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I see... Interesting...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Panicked, I explain what Mayano Top
Gun meant
to avoid any
misunderstandings.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey! I said what I said! Don't go making
excuses
to play dumb!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You can't stop it, Trainer! You can't stop
us from
being together! Got it? ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Sometimes I'm not quite sure what to
do with
her. Anyway, I clear things up
with the reporter.
